formulas.usage_sums: sum(response.usage[field]) over selected unique responseIds; no deduplication of cached context across responses
formulas.usage_cost_sums: math.fsum(response.usage.cost[field]) over selected unique responseIds; floating-point arithmetic, not validated billing
formulas.reported_total_identity: for each response: totalTokens == input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite (observed identity, not proof of provider semantics)

semantic_checks.accounting_interpretation: response-associated usage snapshots; input/output/reasoning/cost vary nonmonotonically, so not one simple session-wide cumulative counter. cacheRead and totalTokens are monotonic here; growing context is compatible but field-specific cumulative semantics cannot be independently excluded. Aggregates are sums of reported fields, conditionally token consumption if fields are per-response.
semantic_checks.input_excludes_cacheRead: plausible from arithmetic and harness field names, not provider-validated
semantic_checks.reasoning_in_output: plausible subset; no separate addition. Arithmetic and reasoning<=output do not prove provider semantics.
semantic_checks.cacheWrite_is_zero: reported zero in all 39 usage records; not absent

cost.reported_location: responses[].usage.cost (original field names and numeric values retained)

timestamp_interpretation.envelope: ISO 8601 timestamp on persisted event; UTC explicit; lifecycle point not documented in this source
timestamp_interpretation.message_timestamp: numeric epoch milliseconds on messages; assistant values tend to precede envelope and follow preceding tool result; request/start hypothesis unconfirmed

historical_instructions.normalization: UTF-8 decoded; CRLF->LF; trim outer whitespace; injected implement body between heading and </skill>, current YAML frontmatter removed. Does not assert frontmatter or full package equality.

reproduction.preserve_zero_vs_absence: reported zeros retained; unavailable observations null; empty observed lists/counters distinct from unknown durations
